title: World public ocean-data sources for SWELLO (stream D, 2026-11-09)
method: Every source was requested with curl (User-Agent 'SWELLO data-source research') on 2026-11-09 UTC where a keyless endpoint exists; `checked` lists the exact URL, HTTP status and a sample of the response. Claims that could not be verified by a request are listed under `reported` with the page they came from. No registration was performed and no terms were accepted. Licence quotes are copied from the licence page named.

statusLegend.checked: a sample request succeeded and the response was inspected
statusLegend.reported: documented on a public page but no machine request was possible (key, registration, DNS, JS-only or blocked)
statusLegend.blocked: the site refused automated access or was down at check time

sources.family: NDBC (NOAA National Data Buoy Center) and international partner buoys
sources.owner: NOAA NDBC; partner owners include Environment and Climate Change Canada, UK Met Office, Korea Meteorological Administration, Australian Bureau of Meteorology, PacIOOS, CarICoos, SCRIPPS (CDIP)
sources.coverage: Global. activestations.xml lists 1,357 stations; latest_obs.txt had 222 stations reporting WVHT, of which 33 ECCC (Canada), 8 KMA (Korea), 3 UK Met Office, 12 PacIOOS, 2 CarICoos, 42 SCRIPPS/CDIP (incl. Hawaii, Guam, Samoa, Puerto Rico).
sources.variables: WVHT, DPD, APD, MWD, WDIR, WSPD, GST, PRES, ATMP, WTMP (standard meteorological file)
sources.updateRate: Hourly (10-30 min for some partners); latest_obs.txt is one file with the newest record per station

access.notes: No CORS headers; SWELLO already proxies NDBC through /api.

licence.text: US federal public data; keep NOAA attribution, provider quality flags and timestamps (NOAA disclaimer https://www.noaa.gov/disclaimer). Partner-owned stations keep their owner attribution from activestations.xml.

sources.swelloUse: Already wired for US buoys. The same code path serves Canada (ECCC: Tofino area 46206/46132/46204), Korea (KMA), UK Met Office K-buoys, Hawaii/Guam/Samoa/Puerto Rico (CDIP via SCRIPPS) and Caribbean (CarICoos). Use activestations.xml owner for attribution and latest_obs.txt for a one-request world snapshot.

checked.sample: 1,357 <station> elements; attributes id, lat, lon, elev, name, owner, pgm, type, met, currents, waterquality, dart (no waves attribute). Owners counted: NDBC 234, NOS 201, ECCC 45, UK Met Office 14, KMA 8, BoM 6, PacIOOS 25, CarICoos 8, NZ NEMA/GNS/NIWA 12 (DART).
817 lines; header '#STN LAT LON YYYY MM DD hh mm WDIR WSPD GST WVHT DPD APD MWD PRES PTDY ATMP WTMP DEWP VIS TIDE'; 222 stations with a WVHT value.
UK Met Office K1 buoy: '2026 11 09 07 00 110 14.9 MM MM MM MM MM 998.2 15.5 14.9 14.2 MM MM MM' (no waves at that hour).
Not every listed partner id has a realtime2 file (62001, 55012, 22101 returned 404).

sources.family: CDIP (Coastal Data Information Program) Pacific islands and Caribbean buoys; PacIOOS SWAN/WW3 (ERDDAP)
sources.owner: Scripps Institution of Oceanography (CDIP, USACE-funded); PacIOOS (University of Hawaii) for SWAN/WW3 grids
sources.coverage: Hawaii (Mokapu 098, Hilo 188, Pearl Harbor 233, Barbers Point 238, Waimea, Pauwela, Hanalei), American Samoa (Aunuu 189, King-Poloa 273), Guam/CNMI, Micronesia (Utwe 276, Pohnpei 178), Marshall Islands (Majuro 163, Arno 282), Palau (219), Puerto Rico; PacIOOS SWAN grids for Oahu, Kauai, Maui, Big Island, Guam, Saipan, Rota, Tutuila, Manua, Palau; WW3 Hawaii and global
sources.variables: waveHs, waveTp, waveDp, SST, currents (buoys, 30-min); SWAN: significant height, period, direction, hourly to about 7 days
sources.updateRate: Buoys every 30 minutes; SWAN runs daily/twice daily (PacIOOS)
sources.format: NetCDF/CSV via THREDDS NCSS (same shape as SWELLO's 029p1 feed); ERDDAP griddap/tabledap

licence.text: CDIP data and products are freely available for public use, provided that they are not altered in any way. When used for web displays and online resources, please provide a link to the CDIP homepage.

sources.swelloUse: Zero new code for the buoys: `cdipBuoyURL('098p1')` already produces the right request. Hawaii is the first world batch (US data, own time zone); Samoa, Guam and Puerto Rico follow. PacIOOS SWAN is a nearshore model analogue to MOP for Hawaii (an engineering task, griddap point extraction).

sources.family: EMODnet Physics ERDDAP (European Marine Observation and Data Network)
sources.owner: EMODnet Physics (EU DG MARE), operated by ETT/OGS consortium; data owners are the national networks
sources.coverage: Global aggregation of in-situ platforms. Platform metadata with waves reporting since 2026-11-01: 750 platforms (USA 182, UK 67, Australia 54, Netherlands 44, Spain 39, Canada 36, France 33, Korea 20, Germany 17, Belgium 16, Norway 15, Japan 13, Iceland 12, Ireland 7, India 7, Portugal 6, Italy 1, Greece 1). Spanish platforms are Puertos del Estado (6100198, 6200082...), French ones Cerema/CANDHIS (6200079 Anglet...), Portuguese ones Instituto Hidrografico (Sines-coast-buoy, Faro-coast-buoy), Irish ones Marine Institute and Met Eireann.
sources.variables: Platform metadata: PLATFORMCODE, platformtypecode (MO mooring, DB drifter, TG tide gauge), owner, country, lat/lon, lastdateobservation, p33_waves flag; time series carry VHM0, VTPK, VMDR, VTM02 (Copernicus in-situ conventions)
sources.updateRate: Near real time (lastdateobservation within hours for active moorings)

access.notes: 804 datasets listed. Per-platform wave time series were NOT found by dataset search on this ERDDAP (searchFor=6100198 returned 404); the metadata table is the verified part. Time series are likely served through the EMODnet Physics data portal or Copernicus INSTAC (registration).

licence.text: Not stated on the ERDDAP information page; EMODnet data policy page (emodnet.ec.europa.eu/en/data-policy) returned 404 at check time. Per-dataset licence attributes vary by owner.

sources.swelloUse: The best single registry for 'nearest real buoy' discovery across Europe and beyond (one keyless query gives every wave platform, owner, position and last observation time). Use it to populate nearestSources with distances; fetch readings from the national source or Copernicus once wired.

checked.sample: 804 lines (datasets incl. EP_PLATFORMS_METADATA_V2, INSITU_GLO_PHY_TS_OA_MY_013_052_*, Sustuntech_Xband_Biarritz).

750 rows; e.g. 6100198,MO,SPAIN,PUERTOS DEL ESTADO,36.57,-2.34; Sines-coast-buoy,MO,PORTUGAL,HYDROGRAPHIC INSTITUTE,37.9211,-8.9289; 6200079,MO,FRANCE,CENTRE FOR STUDIES ON RISKS...,43.403,-1.6766; 55030,MO,AUSTRALIA,DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT AND...,-26.57,153.18.
No per-platform dataset found by search.

sources.family: Copernicus Marine Service: in-situ TAC (INSITU_GLO_PHYBGCWAV_DISCRETE_MYNRT_013_030) and Global Ocean Waves Analysis and Forecast (GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_WAV_001_027, MFWAM)
sources.owner: Mercator Ocean International for the EU Copernicus programme; wave model by Meteo-France (MFWAM)
sources.coverage: Global. Wave forecast 1/12 degree, 3-hourly, daily analyses and 10-day forecasts; in-situ TAC aggregates national buoys (the same platforms EMODnet lists).
sources.variables: Forecast: VHM0, VTPK, VMDR, VTM02, VHM0_WW, VHM0_SW1, VHM0_SW2 with directions and periods (wind wave, primary and secondary swell partitions), Stokes drift. In situ: VHM0, VTPK, VMDR, VTM02, TEMP, PSAL, SLEV.
sources.updateRate: Forecast daily (12:00 UTC); in situ NRT hourly files
sources.format: NetCDF via copernicusmarine toolbox, S3 native files, OPeNDAP/WMTS

access.notes: Free account required; products are accessible from the Web Portal with a single password. Not registered during this research.

licence.text: Copernicus Marine Services and products are free of charge for the User until this date [30 June 2028]. ... ANNEX LICENCE TO USE THE COPERNICUS MARINE SERVICE PRODUCTS ... This Licence Agreement is a legal agreement between the Licensee and MERCATOR OCEAN (Service Level Agreement, November 2023). Attribution to 'E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information' and the product DOI (10.48670/moi-00017 for the wave forecast) is required.

sources.swelloUse: The strongest global model alternative to Open-Meteo's combined Hs: 1/12 degree MFWAM with swell partitions, free for commercial use with attribution. Needs a server-side fetch with credentials stored as a secret (never in the client) and a data-honesty review of the licence text before launch.

checked.sample: SLA text: 'All the products are accessible directly from the Web Portal portal: a centralised access with a single password'; 'free of charge for the User until this date'; Annex 'LICENCE TO USE THE COPERNICUS MARINE SERVICE PRODUCTS'.

'resolution of 1/12 degree is providing daily analyses and 10 days forecasts for the global ocean sea surface waves ... 3-hourly instantaneous fields ... wind wave, the primary and secondary swell waves ... MFWAM'. DOI 10.48670/moi-00017.

reported.source: CMEMS product user manuals (CMEMS-INS-PUM-013-046) and the SLA 'single password' statement

sources.owner: Marine Institute (Ireland), with Met Eireann and the Irish National Tide Gauge Network partners
sources.coverage: Ireland: weather buoys M2-M6 (hourly waves), Irish Wave Buoy Network (IWaveBNetwork, 30-min), Irish National Tide Gauge Network (5-min observed levels at about 30 ports: Castletownbere, Ballycotton, Aranmore...), tide predictions for about 40 sites (imiTidePrediction), Irish Shelf and Connemara SWAN wave models

licence.text: license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) (dataset attribute of IWBNetwork, institution Marine Institute)

sources.family: Puertos del Estado (Spain): Portus real-time buoys and REDMAR tide gauges; OPeNDAP/THREDDS
sources.owner: Puertos del Estado (Spanish state ports authority)
sources.coverage: Spain incl. Canary Islands and Balearics: deep-water buoy network (REDEXT) and coastal network (REDCOS); REDMAR tide gauges at about 40 ports (Bilbao, Santander, Gijon, La Coruna, Vigo, Huelva, Tarifa, Las Palmas, Tenerife, Arrecife, Fuerteventura, La Palma, El Hierro, La Gomera...). EMODnet lists 39 PdE wave platforms reporting in November 2026 (WMO ids 61xxxxx/62xxxxx).
sources.variables: Hs, Tp, Tm, direction, wind, SST, currents (buoys); sea level (tide gauges); forecast fields (wave models) on THREDDS
sources.updateRate: Buoys hourly; tide gauges every minute; forecasts twice daily (per Puertos del Estado FAQ and iMar app page)
endpoints: https://portus.puertos.es/ (Angular app; backend portussvr/api exists but request shape undocumented: GET 405, POST 400)
https://opendap.puertos.es/thredds/catalog.html (Medidas: Mareografos, Nivel del Mar per port; Radares; Modelos; wave_coast_s01 = Gijon hourly HW-*.nc)
sources.format: NetCDF via THREDDS/OPeNDAP (tide gauges, models); Portus web app and widgets for buoys

access.notes: THREDDS is open; Portus historical download is free online but the buoy real-time JSON API is unpublished. No documented licence for redistribution.

licence.text: Puertos del Estado only authorises the use of the data for the specific purpose of the download ... under no circumstances is the transfer of the data to third parties permitted ... the source, Puertos del Estado, must always be duly accredited.

sources.swelloUse: Spain and the Canaries have the densest coastal buoy network in Europe, but the FAQ forbids transfer to third parties, so showing PdE readings in SWELLO needs written permission (or use the same buoys through Copernicus in-situ TAC under the Copernicus licence). Tide gauges: REDMAR levels are also redistributed by IOC Sea Level Monitoring (52 ESP stations) and by Copernicus. Record positions for nearestSources now; wire later.

checked.sample: Catalog: Medidas > Mareografos > Nivel del Mar > Algeciras, Alcudia, Almeria, Arrecife, Aviles2, Barcelona, Bilbao, Bonanza, ... Las Palmas, ... Santander, ... Tenerife, Valencia, Vigo, Villagarcia; Radares; Satelite; Modelos.

'This online service is available free of charge in the Historical Data section'; 'Deep-water and coastal buoys provide hourly data'; terms quoted in licence.

sources.owner: NNRCMP, hosted by the Channel Coastal Observatory (New Forest District Council / University of Southampton)

sources.swelloUse: The best UK surf-buoy source: nearshore buoys off the actual surf beaches (Perranporth, Porthleven, Boscombe) with a documented JSON API, OGL, free key. Needs the key registered for swello's domain and the exact attribution string in the UI.
